dnf: u_new psi ivec = 0.25 * sum_{ (di,dj) in {(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)} } (ivec+(di,dj)) psi u + h^2 * (ivec psi f) # Poisson stencil DNF, rav + gamma_col
onf: ONF RBGS: same DNF, split by parity: phase color=0: ivec where mod(i+j,2)==0, phase color=1: ivec where mod(i+j,2)==1, in-place, no second array, gamma_col
rav: rav A = A(:) in column-major order
psi: ivec psi A = (rav A)[gamma(ivec, rho A)]
